response.sql: SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(l.RBC) AS avg_rbc, AVG(l.GOT) - o.overall_got AS got_diff FROM Laboratory l CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_got FROM Laboratory) o WHERE o.overall_got IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.ID, o.overall_got ORDER BY got_diff IS NULL, got_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall GOT figure is AVG(GOT) over all Laboratory rows with a non-null GOT, so it is weighted by record count, as 'across all laboratory records' implies. If no GOT value exists, the WHERE clause returns no rows.
Each patient's difference is their average GOT minus that single overall figure, and a patient whose GOT values are all null gets a null difference and sorts last.
Ties in got_diff are ordered arbitrarily, since the request does not specify a secondary sort.
